items.title: Louis Armstrong Interview, 1960-08-09
items.q: Mr. Armstrong and his guest students from the University of Pittsburgh, Fernando Escribins from Caracas, Venezuela... We'll discuss Mr. Armstrong's role as an ambassador of goodwill

ctx.x: We are privileged to meet Mr. Roy Armstrong, the internationally known New Orleans jazz trumpeter and band leader. In this second program, Mr. Armstrong and his guest students from the University of Pittsburgh, Fernando Escribins from Caracas, Venezuela, Verdeet Valerius Olsen from Stockholm, Sweden, Stefan Villas-Scher from Coutre, Belgium. We'll discuss Mr. Armstrong's role as an ambassador of goodwill through his travels around the world.

When you were in Stockholm, Sweden, I know you draw tremendous crowds. And although I didn't get to see you the last time you were in Stockholm, I know that the audience never lets you leave the stage and repeat all the time. That's right.
